title: Fourth Order Section Filter
text: Implement cascade of fourth-order section filters, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Coefficient source} sets Filter coefficient source Dialog; {Numerator coefficients of filter} sets the numerator coefficients, {Denominator coefficients of filter} sets the denominator coefficients {Filter}, {View Filter Response} sets the visualize frequency response and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
